summary: GoldMining Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release and an NI 43-101 technical report containing a preliminary economic assessment (PEA) for its La Mina Project in Colombia. The PEA reports base-case after-tax NPV5% of $1.0B and IRR of 32.2% with 2.7-year payback. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situations event. The filing is a routine disclosure of a project update and technical report, not a corporate transaction or strategic change.
